name: Georgetown College
academic_ranking: Private, Baptist-affiliated Christian liberal arts college founded in 1829 in Georgetown, KY. Baccalaureate College - Arts & Sciences; offers 40+ undergraduate programs plus a Master of Arts in Education. Undergraduate enrollment ~1,097; acceptance rate ~91%.
financial_aid: 2024-25 undergraduate tuition & fees approx. $42,840 (well above the average for baccalaureate colleges); additional living costs ~$14,000/year. NAIA athletic scholarships are available and renewable through the eighth semester provided GPA requirements are met; students must file the FAFSA each year to renew need-based aid. All student-athletes must be cleared by the NAIA Eligibility Center (playnaia.org).
facilities_notes: Home softball venue is the Tiger Softball Complex, 794 Lemons Mill Rd, Georgetown, KY 40324.
program_reputation: Established NAIA program competing in the Mid-South Conference (MSC) since 1995-96. Multiple-time MSC regular season champions and Georgetown's first NAIA national tournament team under head coach Thomas Thornton. Recent NAIA All-Americans include Madison Diaz and Maggie Byrd; Haylee Stansbury named MSC Champion of Character.
